This '''confrontation''' occurred on the [[Stenness Hyperspace Terminal]] in [[3999 BBY]], when [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] sent a group of his [[Bogga's enforcer gang|enforcers]] to steal a package of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]] from [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Andur Sunrider]] and his [[Sunrider family|family]]. Sunrider was killed in the fight by enforcer [[Gudb]]'s pet [[Gorm-worm/Legends|gorm-worm]], [[Skritch]], but his wife [[Nomi Sunrider]] took his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and fought the thugs off.
